subject: How to access the data frame in shiny

messages.author: 862dcfdada8cc0b2
messages.subject: How to access the data frame in shiny
parts:
I have created one data frame say da. I tried this code


 daa <- reactive({
 lapply(da, as.character)
})
 
output$downloadData <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() { paste('summary', '.csv', sep='') },
  content = function(file) {
    write.csv(da, file)
  })

But it gives a message `da` not found. I am not sure to access the data frame created. Help appreciated

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: How to access the data frame in shiny
parts:

and when you go to write.csv you are referencing 'da'.  Your write.csv should be calling daa()  I believe.

  })

messages.subject: Re: How to access the data frame in shiny
parts:
With this little modification i am able to access my data frame now but unable to download.
I am going wrong somewhere but can not make it out.

data <- reactive({
    if (is.null(input$file1))
      {
      return(NULL)
      }
    if(is.null(input$file2))
    {
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    df <- read.csv(input$file1$datapath) # read the file
    df1 <- read.csv(input$file2$datapath)
    da=data.frame()
    d <- nrow(df)
    d1 <- nrow(df1)
    p=1
    for(i in 1:d)
    {
      for(j in 1:d1)
      {
        if(df[i,3]=="P") 
        {
          da[p,1] = df1[i,10]
          da[p,2] =df[i,3]
    
        }
      
      }
      p=p+1
    }
    da  # data.frame(da)
  })
output$final <- renderDataTable({ 
  data()

})
 
output$downloadData <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() { paste('summary', '.csv', sep='') },
  content = function(file) {

write.csv(data(), file)
  })

})
